head.title: Multiple Manipulations E2E
head.teaser: A game that builds one table across several manipulation scenes.

text-scene.text: Add four entries and occasionally inspect the newest one.

select-scene.text: Get the entry with the highest ID.
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT label FROM entries WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM entries)
